Characters apply idea; clear satisfying resolution with warm celebration and original musical/funny beat.
One short take-home lesson or invitation to try with a grown-up; end cleanly.

correct YouTube channel + Made for Kids + 18:00 Oslo + no duplicate release

pilot.voiceoverEnglish: CRASH! Milo’s block tower fell! “Oh no!” cried Milo. Miko the meerkat looked at the tiny bottom block. “That’s a wobbly base!” Pip the little blue bird chirped, “Let’s count three BIG blocks!” One... two... three! Milo stacked them wide at the bottom. Then he carefully added little blocks on top. Uh-oh... wobble, wobble! Everybody froze. And... it stayed up! “We did it!” cheered Milo. Big blocks at the bottom make our tower steadier. Can you build one, too?
